title: The top bar
summary: What every readout at the top of the screen means.
text:
- **◆ Alloys**: what you build with
- **◇ Isotopes**: for advanced buildings and research (dim until you have a use for them)
- **⚡ Power**: made / wanted, in MW. Amber: on the batteries. Red: the cryo bank is short
- **🔋 Battery**: how full the batteries are
- **❄ Cryo bank**: embryos left and integrity. Red below 50%
- **🌱 Biomass**: food held, and the change per minute
- **👤 Colonists**: people, + any in pods (tap for the Colony panel)
- **☺ ⚖**: average wellbeing and acceptance of you
- **🌍 Planet health**: out of 100
- **Clock**: the sol, the hour, ☀ or ☾
- **⚠ Threat**: predators on the map, or (with a Radar) when the next pack is due
- **⚔ Army**: combat units (tap to select them all)
- **⛭ Drones**: worker drones, and how many are idle

A readout that doesn't apply yet shows a dim —. On a computer, hover over one for more.
